F1: exact restored state can reach PASS
present/restored wrong bytes, digest or identity -> FAILED_VERIFICATION
mixed state containing positive mismatch evidence remains FAILED_VERIFICATION
F2: after a completed-stage continuation, a W-04-forbidden/unexpected non-ISSUE event -> FAILED_VERIFICATION
after a completed-stage continuation, only W-04-permitted tuple-extending ISSUE events -> REFUSED_PRECONDITION
the same semantic event receives the same W-04 classification regardless of chain shape
the sealed verifier is not modified to make the REFUSED_PRECONDITION state capable of producing W
F3: successful verification, W retention and PASS recording occur within the same protected action
ordinary authority mutation cannot interleave between the verified authority state and the durable W/PASS transition
F4: pre-U and dedicated U issuance reject a hand-constructed W lacking producer evidence
they reject a W lacking its corresponding retained PASS
they reject a W paired with a mismatched PASS
they reject a W from the wrong producer root or attempt
they reject a W whose required chain/evidence bindings do not match
they reject a W later revoked under the existing authority semantics
a valid producer-created W with its matching PASS and currently admissible authority state continues to progress
existing legitimate W flows remain valid
the generic append mechanism need not be modified; operational consumers refuse a W lacking admissibility evidence

F1_check_order.UNAVAILABLE_only: where the failure is availability/readability and there is no evidence that the retained expected artifact has been substituted, altered or otherwise mismatched
F1_check_order.restoration: may only restore the exact previously expected artifact; it must never authorize replacement scientific material
F1_check_order.rule: check the available durable artifacts for identity/content mismatch before classifying absence; one expected artifact present with wrong bytes/hash/identity and another missing or unreadable is FAILED_VERIFICATION, not UNAVAILABLE

F3_preserved_classifications.qualification: demonstrate the ordinary protected transition; do not invent special production behavior solely to make exceptional tampering/drift cases produce a tidy outcome
rule: W, its retained record and PASS recording move inside the protected action
an unexpected exception during the durable writes propagates without manufacturing a scientific outcome
if the protected post-action recheck fails after the writes, that integrity failure propagates
no second contradictory outcome is appended because PASS may already have been durably written

F4_A1_A6.A6: a W that was validly produced and received PASS but has since been revoked is not operationally admissible for progression toward U; this verifies the current authority status of the already-produced W and introduces no new scientific verification rule
F4_A1_A6.A6_limit: do not broaden A6 into a requirement that there be no later events whatsoever; later events matter only insofar as existing authority semantics make W no longer admissible
F4_A1_A6.excluded: template revalidation during U issuance remains outside seal 06
F4_A1_A6.rule: the read-only verify_operational_w(authority) may use A1-A6 to establish that the W consumed by pre-U and dedicated U issuance is operationally admissible under the existing authority/evidence model
